title: Knocked Back Canadian Gobo Burdock Stew
description: A hearty and comforting Canadian stew featuring gobo burdock, perfect for a sick day, made with a tadka for added depth of flavor and following satvik principles for a nourishing meal.
instructions: In a large pot, melt 2 tablespoons of butter over medium heat.
Add the sliced gobo burdock and cook until it starts to soften, about 5 minutes.
Add the chopped onion, minced garlic, and grated ginger to the pot and cook until the onion is translucent.
Add the cumin seeds and coriander seeds to the pot and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Pour in the vegetable broth and bring the mixture to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer the stew for 20 minutes, or until the gobo burdock is tender.
Season the stew with salt and black pepper to taste.
Serve the stew hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
